title: Retain left/right multiplication in a noncommuting entropy construction
statement: The actual BKM denominator has BOTH L_tau_i and R_tau_i coupled to two positive reference-effect families whose combined sum is identity. Gauging out the common reference leaves the stated centered inverse expression. Universal comparison over two unrestricted families is sufficient and admits a finite free-pencil upper operation. Actual modular families have additional compatibility; necessity for arbitrary prepared-output comparison is unproved. The SAMEbinary coefficient identity is a finite mechanical check, not that necessity theorem.
